2 Introduction

Integrated population model demonstration for the Whakatipu takahe, using simulated data. Uses nimble package.

2.1 Structure

Population process:
    N[t+1] = S[t] * N[t] + R[t]
    where R[t] = λ[t] * nests[t] * J[t]

Adult survival:
    telemetry data -> estimate S[t]
    y[i,t] ~ Bernoulli(S[t])

Nest productivity:
    chicks[i,t] ~ Poisson(λ[t]) or observed counts
    λ[t] = mean chicks per nest

Juvenile survival:
    yearling_count[i,t+1] ~ Binomial(chicks[i,t], J[t])
    J[t] = juvenile survival probability. 
    chicks[i,t] = chicks fledged

Recruitment:
    R[t] = λ[t] * nests[t] * J[t]
    nests[t] = total nests (estimated from breeding pairs)

This assumes that the nesting pairs monitored are representative of the population. If this is true, it does not matter that different pairs are monitored each year.

3 Data

Use example parameters to simulate data.

3.1 Parameters

Parameters 
# Parameters
n_years <- 5
n_adults <- 50
# n_nests <- 8 # nests monitored
true_S <- rep(0.85, n_years-1)   # adult survival
true_J <- rep(0.5, n_years-1)    # juvenile survival
true_lambda <- rep(2, n_years-1) # chicks per nest
true_N <- numeric(n_years)
true_N[1] <- 50

# Total breeding pairs (estimated)
nests <- c(25, 28, 31, 29)

# Monitored nests
m <- c(5, 8, 12, 6)

year_nest <- c(
  rep(1, m[1]),
  rep(2, m[2]),
  rep(3, m[3]),
  rep(4, m[4])
)

n_nests_total <- length(year_nest)

3.2 Simulate data

Simulate data 
# ---------------------------
# Simulate example data
# ---------------------------
set.seed(123)
# Population process
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  R <- true_lambda[t] * nests[t] * true_J[t]
  true_N[t+1] <- rpois(1,true_N[t] * true_S[t] + R
  )
}

# Telemetry survival data
adult_survival <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_adults, ncol=n_years-1)
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  adult_survival[,t] <- rbinom(n_adults, 1, true_S[t])
}

# Nest productivity and yearling data
total_obs <- sum(m)

chicks <- numeric(total_obs)
yearlings <- numeric(total_obs)
nest_year_index <- numeric(total_obs)

idx <- 1
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  for(i in 1:m[t]) {
    nest_year_index[idx] <- t
    chicks[idx] <- rpois(1,true_lambda[t]    )
    yearlings[idx] <- rbinom(1,chicks[idx],true_J[t])
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}



# Counts
count <- true_N

4 Integrated population model

4.1 Define IPM

Define IPM in Nimble

Define IPM 
# ---------------------------
# Define IPM in NIMBLE
# ---------------------------
ipm_code <- nimbleCode({

  # Parameters
  for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
    S[t] ~ dbeta(2, 2)
    J[t] ~ dbeta(2, 2)
    lambda[t] ~ dgamma(2, 1)
  }

  # Initial abundance
  N[1] ~ dpois(init_N)

  # Population process
  for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
    # nests[t] = total breeding pairs in year t
    R[t] <- lambda[t] * nests[t] * J[t]
    N[t+1] ~ dpois(N[t] * S[t] + R[t])
  }

  # Adult survival data
  for(i in 1:n_adults) {
    for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
      y[i,t] ~ dbern(S[t])
    }
  }

  # Nest productivity data
  # year_nest[i] indicates which year nest i belongs to
  for(i in 1:n_nests_total) {

    #chicks[i] ~ dpois(lambda[year_nest[i]])

    yearlings[i] ~ dbinom(
      prob = J[year_nest[i]],
      size = chicks[i]
    )
  }

  # Count data
  for(t in 1:n_years) {
    count[t] ~ dpois(N[t])
  }
})

4.3 Run model

Run IPM 
# ---------------------------
# Step 4: Build and run the model
# ---------------------------
tic()
ipm_model <- nimbleModel(code = ipm_code, data = data, constants = constants, inits = inits)
ipm_conf <- configureMCMC(ipm_model, monitors = c("S", "J", "lambda", "N"))
===== Monitors =====
thin = 1: J, lambda, N, S
===== Samplers =====
slice sampler (5)
  - N[]  (5 elements)
RW sampler (12)
  - S[]  (4 elements)
  - J[]  (4 elements)
  - lambda[]  (4 elements)
Run IPM 
ipm_mcmc <- buildMCMC(ipm_conf)

Cmodel <- compileNimble(ipm_model)
Cmcmc <- compileNimble(ipm_mcmc, project = ipm_model)
samples <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = 10000, nburnin = 2000, thin = 10)
|-------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|
|-------------------------------------------------------|
Run IPM 
toc()
30.502 sec elapsed

5.2.3 Density plots

Density plots 
# Density plots using ggplot2
posterior_df <- as.data.frame(mcmc_samples) 
# Remove [ and ] from column names
names(posterior_df) <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", names(posterior_df))


ls_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = S1:S4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Survival')

# Adult survival
ggplot(ls_post_df, aes(x=Survival, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_S, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: Adult Survival', x='Adult survival', y='Density')
Density plots 
lj_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = J1:J4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Survival')

ggplot(lj_post_df, aes(x=Survival, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_J, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: Juvenile Survival', x='Survival', y='Density')
Density plots 
# Lambda (mean chicks per nest)
ll_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = lambda1:lambda4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Lambda')

ggplot(ll_post_df, aes(x=Lambda, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_lambda, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: mean chicks per nest', x='Mean chicks per nest', y='Density')

# Introduction

Integrated population model demonstration for the Whakatipu takahe, using simulated data. Uses `nimble` package.

## Structure
```
Population process:
    N[t+1] = S[t] * N[t] + R[t]
    where R[t] = λ[t] * nests[t] * J[t]

Adult survival:
    telemetry data -> estimate S[t]
    y[i,t] ~ Bernoulli(S[t])

Nest productivity:
    chicks[i,t] ~ Poisson(λ[t]) or observed counts
    λ[t] = mean chicks per nest

Juvenile survival:
    yearling_count[i,t+1] ~ Binomial(chicks[i,t], J[t])
    J[t] = juvenile survival probability. 
    chicks[i,t] = chicks fledged

Recruitment:
    R[t] = λ[t] * nests[t] * J[t]
    nests[t] = total nests (estimated from breeding pairs)
```

This assumes that the nesting pairs monitored are representative of the population. If this is true, it does not matter that different pairs are monitored each year.

# Data

Use example parameters to simulate data.

## Parameters

```{r}
#| label: params
#| code-summary: "Parameters"
#| message: false

# Parameters
n_years <- 5
n_adults <- 50
# n_nests <- 8 # nests monitored
true_S <- rep(0.85, n_years-1)   # adult survival
true_J <- rep(0.5, n_years-1)    # juvenile survival
true_lambda <- rep(2, n_years-1) # chicks per nest
true_N <- numeric(n_years)
true_N[1] <- 50

# Total breeding pairs (estimated)
nests <- c(25, 28, 31, 29)

# Monitored nests
m <- c(5, 8, 12, 6)

year_nest <- c(
  rep(1, m[1]),
  rep(2, m[2]),
  rep(3, m[3]),
  rep(4, m[4])
)

n_nests_total <- length(year_nest)
```

## Simulate data

```{r}
#| label: simulate_data
#| code-summary: "Simulate data"
#| message: false


# ---------------------------
# Simulate example data
# ---------------------------
set.seed(123)
# Population process
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  R <- true_lambda[t] * nests[t] * true_J[t]
  true_N[t+1] <- rpois(1,true_N[t] * true_S[t] + R
  )
}

# Telemetry survival data
adult_survival <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_adults, ncol=n_years-1)
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  adult_survival[,t] <- rbinom(n_adults, 1, true_S[t])
}

# Nest productivity and yearling data
total_obs <- sum(m)

chicks <- numeric(total_obs)
yearlings <- numeric(total_obs)
nest_year_index <- numeric(total_obs)

idx <- 1
for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
  for(i in 1:m[t]) {
    nest_year_index[idx] <- t
    chicks[idx] <- rpois(1,true_lambda[t]    )
    yearlings[idx] <- rbinom(1,chicks[idx],true_J[t])
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}



# Counts
count <- true_N
```

# Integrated population model

## Define IPM

Define IPM in Nimble

```{r}
#| label: define_ipm
#| code-summary: "Define IPM"
#| message: false
# ---------------------------
# Define IPM in NIMBLE
# ---------------------------
ipm_code <- nimbleCode({

  # Parameters
  for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
    S[t] ~ dbeta(2, 2)
    J[t] ~ dbeta(2, 2)
    lambda[t] ~ dgamma(2, 1)
  }

  # Initial abundance
  N[1] ~ dpois(init_N)

  # Population process
  for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
    # nests[t] = total breeding pairs in year t
    R[t] <- lambda[t] * nests[t] * J[t]
    N[t+1] ~ dpois(N[t] * S[t] + R[t])
  }

  # Adult survival data
  for(i in 1:n_adults) {
    for(t in 1:(n_years-1)) {
      y[i,t] ~ dbern(S[t])
    }
  }

  # Nest productivity data
  # year_nest[i] indicates which year nest i belongs to
  for(i in 1:n_nests_total) {

    #chicks[i] ~ dpois(lambda[year_nest[i]])

    yearlings[i] ~ dbinom(
      prob = J[year_nest[i]],
      size = chicks[i]
    )
  }

  # Count data
  for(t in 1:n_years) {
    count[t] ~ dpois(N[t])
  }
})
  
```

```{r}
cat("### Inits ###\n")

inits <- list(
  S = true_S, # rep(0.8, n_years-1),
  J = true_J, # rep(0.5, n_years-1),
  lambda = true_lambda, # rep(2, n_years-1),
  N = count
)
inits
```


## Run model

```{r}
#| label: run_ipm
#| code-summary: "Run IPM"
#| message: false
# ---------------------------
# Step 4: Build and run the model
# ---------------------------
tic()
ipm_model <- nimbleModel(code = ipm_code, data = data, constants = constants, inits = inits)
ipm_conf <- configureMCMC(ipm_model, monitors = c("S", "J", "lambda", "N"))
ipm_mcmc <- buildMCMC(ipm_conf)

Cmodel <- compileNimble(ipm_model)
Cmcmc <- compileNimble(ipm_mcmc, project = ipm_model)
samples <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = 10000, nburnin = 2000, thin = 10)
toc()
```

# Results

## Print results

```{r}
#| label: print_results
#| code-summary: "Print results"
#| message: false

print(summary(samples))
```

### Density plots

```{r}
#| label: density_plots
#| code-summary: "Density plots"
#| message: false

# Density plots using ggplot2
posterior_df <- as.data.frame(mcmc_samples) 
# Remove [ and ] from column names
names(posterior_df) <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", names(posterior_df))


ls_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = S1:S4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Survival')

# Adult survival
ggplot(ls_post_df, aes(x=Survival, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_S, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: Adult Survival', x='Adult survival', y='Density')

lj_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = J1:J4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Survival')

ggplot(lj_post_df, aes(x=Survival, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_J, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: Juvenile Survival', x='Survival', y='Density')

# Lambda (mean chicks per nest)
ll_post_df <- posterior_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = lambda1:lambda4, names_to = 'Year', values_to = 'Lambda')

ggplot(ll_post_df, aes(x=Lambda, colour = Year, fill = Year )) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_lambda, linetype = 'dotted') +
  labs(title='Posterior Distribution: mean chicks per nest', x='Mean chicks per nest', y='Density')




```
